requirements.source_text: If the user cancels the order while it is not preparing/confirmed yet, they should be able to cancel it.
Otherwise they must request it from the venue; the frontend stays the same, but instead of auto-cancelling it asks the venue.
Customers should not be able to refund unless the venue has authorized or refunded it for the user.
After a 24-hour window past the end of operating hours the user cannot request a refund; only the venue can refund, and the venue may refund after more than 24 h.
Refunds must be safe to retry and reconcile: money moves at most once and the ledger reflects it exactly once (B04 review of PR #2).
Old refunds should be maintained in history.
Unanswered requests stay visible to the cashier for now; an Expired tab may be created later.
The customer can ask again after a request is declined.
